title: Technical Support Expert
description:
**Technical Support Expert – International Process**

**Location:** Jaipur, Rajasthan  
**Work Mode:** Work From Office  
**Job Type:** Full\-Time  
**Shift:** Majorly Night Shifts \| Rotational

**Key Responsibilities**

* Handle customer interactions through voice and blended channels.
* Resolve technical and customer\-related queries effectively.
* Handle billing and retention\-related concerns.
* Maintain quality, productivity, and customer satisfaction standards.
* Identify opportunities for cross\-selling and upselling.

**Eligibility**

* Graduate candidates only.
* Minimum 1 year of professional work experience in international Technical Support/Customer Service/Sales.
* Valid employment and experience verification documents are mandatory.
* Sales or BPO experience will be preferred.
* Excellent English communication skills.
* Good technical aptitude and customer\-handling skills.

**Schedule \& Benefits**

* 5 days working.
* 2 rotational week\-offs.
* Majorly night shifts with rotational timings.
* 10 hours shift including 1\-hour break.
* Cab facility for eligible night shifts.
* No leave during the first 3 months, except weekly offs.

Relocation Benefits

Eligible outstation Jaipur Rajasthan candidates may receive:

* 10 days free stay on dual occupancy.
* One\-way bus/train/flight ticket.
* Relocation bonus up to ₹10,000\.

**Interested candidates can share their updated resume**80102O7552

Pay: ₹44,000\.00 \- ₹46,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Work from home

Education:

* Bachelor's (Required)

Experience:

* Technical support: 1 year (Required)

Work Location: In person
